value.rationale: A full natural cardinality polynomial for inclusion-minimal strong total covers on every finite simple graph, with a unique structural decomposition and O(3^n poly(n)) arithmetic evaluation in original vertex count. This refines a new optimization invariant and is neither a special-graph recomputation nor a mere restatement of minimum cover size.
